content: piper-tts on pypi (current maintainer OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl) is GPL-3.0-or-later, v1.6.0 (uploaded 2026-07-23), win_amd64 wheel ~33MB, requires onnxruntime (13MB win_amd64/cp311 wheel) + pathvalidate. Original rhasspy/piper (MIT) is archived as of Oct 2025; the actively maintained package changed license to GPL-3.0. Voice models are separate .onnx+.onnx.json downloads, medium quality ~70-75MB each.
